description: Source code for HR timesheet management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, defining classes for employee extension and timesheet line handling with related methods.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Extension of hr.employee with additional product and journal fields.

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Timesheet line class inheriting from account.analytic.line with methods for CRUD, onchange, and default values.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes timesheet lines and associated analytic lines.

methods.name: on_change_unit_amount
methods.description: Handles onchange event for unit amount, delegating to related analytic line.

methods.name: _getEmployeeProduct
methods.description: Retrieves product ID associated with the current user’s employee record.

methods.name: _getEmployeeUnit
methods.description: Retrieves unit of measure ID for the employee’s product.

methods.name: _getGeneralAccount
methods.description: Retrieves expense account ID for the employee’s product or category.

methods.name: _getAnalyticJournal
methods.description: Retrieves analytic journal ID for the employee.

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Placeholder for onchange event when account is changed.

methods.name: on_change_date
methods.description: Warns user when changing date to inform timesheet entry will update.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet line, with error handling for missing journal or account.

methods.name: on_change_user_id
methods.description: Updates related fields when user_id is changed.
